title: The Open Trail
author: Elodie Amberdale
blurb: Coral Joubert, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must cross the range ahead of the snows before the concession permits expire.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
